name: Tsurutsuru Nurse "Hazukashii...... Konna no Dare ni mo Miserarenai......"
original_name: つるつるナース「恥ずかしい……こんなの誰にも見せられない……」
source:
Tooru is a university student. One day, he starts working at a part-time job where he experiments with a new medicine. He just needs to stay at a hospital and take the medicine for a week. 

But a trouble happens on the second day! His dick gets two times bigger than usual and his pubic hair is like an afro. The doctor soon shaves off his pubic hair, but it grows back rapidly. Tooru gets mad and says, "I'll sue you!" 

"Calm down. You can shave off my pubic hair..." The nurse tells him. On the next day, Tooru is sent to a special room to hide the fact... Instead, beautiful nurses visit his room to shave off his pubic hair every day. They also give him a blowjob after shaving! Days later, he suddenly makes a suggestion that the nurses should shave off their pubic hair as well...

translation:
彻是一名大学生。一天，他开始参加一份测试新药的兼职，只需住进医院，连续服药一周。

然而第二天就发生了问题！他的阴茎变成平时两倍大，阴毛也长得如同爆炸头。医生立刻替他剃掉阴毛，它们却迅速重新长出。彻愤怒地说道：“我要起诉你们！”

“冷静一点。你可以剃掉我的阴毛…”护士对他说。第二天，为了掩盖事实，彻被送进一间特殊病房…作为交换，每天都会有美丽护士来到病房，替他剃掉阴毛，剃完后还会为他口交！几天后，彻突然提议，让护士们也把自己的阴毛剃掉…
